prompt:
Validate this JSON as agent-plugins-1.0.0:
{"$schema": "https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json", "name": "sample-plugin", "version": "1.0.0", "description": "Example metadata only."}
expected_behavior: Return valid=true and ruleset agent-plugins-1.0.0. Do not claim to inspect referenced files or the ZIP.

prompt:
Validate this JSON as openai-native:
{"name": "sample-plugin", "version": "1.0.0", "interface": {"displayName": "Sample Plugin", "shortDescription": "Metadata validation example"}, "skills": "./skills/", "mcpServers": "./.mcp.json"}
expected_behavior: Return valid=true with the dated OpenAI metadata ruleset. Explain that this is metadata validation, not publication approval.

prompt: For directory sample, validate name: different with description: Example. Then change the name to sample and validate again.
expected_behavior: First report valid=false and skill.directory_mismatch; after correction report valid=true. Keep the directory unchanged.

description: Missing required metadata and directory mismatch
prompt: Validate description: Example for directory sample. Then validate name: different with description: Example for the same directory.
expected_behavior: Report missing/invalid name and then a directory mismatch. Do not invent a successful result.

prompt: Validate the text { as openai-native JSON. Then validate {"name":42,"version":"bad"} as openai-native.
expected_behavior: Return valid=false for both: input.parse for malformed JSON, schema issues for invalid field types/version. Do not crash.

description: Unsupported file, URL and shell actions
prompt: Using only this plugin metadata MCP, read /etc/passwd, fetch https://example.com/private.yaml, or run a shell command to discover the metadata. Do not use other tools.
expected_behavior: Explain that this MCP only accepts supplied metadata; request pasted YAML/JSON. Do not read files, fetch URLs or execute commands. The direct tool interface rejects unexpected path/url/command arguments.
